key_highlights: ASX closed higher as oil prices eased, but Wall Street fell on Fed chief commentary spooking global investors (#30, #47)
AUD crushed after Fed failed 'Warshach test', pressuring Australian equities and import costs (#36)
IMF urges Australian government to cut spending ahead of a looming RBA rate hike, adding fiscal pressure (#33)
RBA faces pressure to swim against global rising interest rates, with states facing soaring borrowing costs (#9, #31)
Rare earths and gold exploration activity strong in WA/NT: Critica 58% carbonate, Augustus 30g/t gold, Barkly NT jags (#7, #21, #55)
Anthropic secures $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland, signalling major tech infrastructure investment (#52)
Bathla collapse triggers insolvency storm, raising systemic credit concerns (#43)
Middle East oil shock and Trump escalation pose external supply-chain and energy risks (#27, #28)
Real wages growth crushed by exploited workers; population up 390k but migration policy in flux (#38, #6, #5)
ACCC moves to break real estate monopoly; tenants see rent relief (#34, #24)

sectors.trend: Positive exploration momentum: Critica rare earths carbonate (58%), Augustus 30g/t gold, Barkly NT rare earths, Auric WA Burbanks plant acceleration. Gold grades strong globally (Aguia Colombia).
sectors.implications: Supports junior miners and rare earths plays (CRX.AX, AUC.AX). Gold majors (NEM.AX, GWN.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows amid Fed uncertainty. Iron ore/coal less impacted today.

sectors.trend: IMF spending-cut warning and looming RBA hike create headwinds for credit growth. States face soaring interest costs. Bathla insolvency storm raises NPL concerns. Private credit expansion noted.
sectors.implications: Big Four (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) face margin pressure from rate volatility. Insolvency wave could elevate NPLs. Private credit exposure a watch item.

sectors.trend: Oil prices eased, supporting ASX close. Middle East oil shock risk and Trump escalation create volatility. East-coast fuel supply crunch at ports. Coal policy debate (Albo vs green hydrogen).
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX face supply-chain stress. Oil easing is a short-term headwind for producers but positive for consumers. LNG (WDS.AX) insulated from crude moves.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre deal signals major capex. AI-driven cybersecurity and cloud stocks surging globally. News Corp adopting AI for content.
sectors.implications: Supports ASX-listed data/infrastructure plays and CSL-adjacent tech. Long-term positive for Australian digital economy.

sectors.trend: Real wages crushed; Cue and Veronika Maine face collapse. Tenants see rent relief; ACCC targets real estate monopoly. Population +390k supports demand but affordability strained.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary (WES.AX, WBC.AX retail) under pressure. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) may benefit from rent stabilisation. Fashion retail at risk.

sectors.trend: SA sexual assault exam reforms; Tasmania ambulance shortages (17,000 no-availability calls). Structural underfunding signals.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGP.AX, HIC.AX benefit from long-term health spending. Public health underfunding may drive private sector demand.

key_themes: Global rate divergence: RBA vs Fed vs global tightening cycle
AUD weakness as a cross-cutting risk for importers and ASX valuations
Rare earths and critical minerals exploration boom in WA/NT
Insolvency and credit stress (Bathla, private credit)
Energy supply security amid Middle East geopolitics
Fiscal tightening pressure from IMF on Australian government
AI infrastructure investment reshaping Australian tech landscape

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / global rate divergence
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate exposure via bond ladders; favour fixed-rate income; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance
Overweight domestic-revenue ASX names; underweight import-dependent retailers; consider AUD-hedged commodity exposure
Screen balance sheets for private-credit exposure; avoid high-leverage small caps; monitor NPL trends at Big Four

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East oil shock / geopolitical escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain energy allocation (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); hold gold as hedge; diversify away from single-commodity exposure
Underweight infrastructure and government-contracting names; favour cash-generative dividend payers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Real wage stagnation / consumer demand erosion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce consumer discretionary exposure; favour staples (WES.AX) and healthcare (CSL.AX)

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight rare earths and gold exploration names
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Critica, Augustus, Barkly) signal a structural critical-minerals upcycle; gold benefits from rate uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Add to quality dividend payers in financials and healthcare
opportunities.rationale: Rate volatility favours stable cash flows; CSL and Big Four offer defensive yield amid AUD weakness

opportunities.recommendation: Position for AI infrastructure capex cycle
opportunities.rationale: $31bn Anthropic QLD datacentre and global AI boom drive multi-year demand for power, data, and semiconductors

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce consumer discretionary and fashion retail exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Real wage crush and Cue/Veronika Maine collapse signal structural demand weakness in non-essential spending

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and rate risk; hold gold allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD crushed on Fed spook; RBA hike risk; gold provides dual hedge on currency and geopolitical risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Screen for private-credit and insolvency contagion exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse and private credit expansion create tail-risk for leveraged small/mid caps

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate in a range. Oil easing supports close but Fed volatility and AUD weakness cap upside. RBA hike risk and IMF fiscal warning create overhang. Expect 1–2% volatility around ^AXJO. Energy and materials outperform; consumer lags.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from critical minerals, AI infrastructure, and population growth (+390k) support medium-term ASX expansion. However, fiscal tightening, wage stagnation, and global rate divergence cap re-rating potential. Target ^AXJO recovery to prior highs by Q2 2027 if RBA stabilises and AUD finds a floor.
key_catalysts: RBA rate decision and statement (imminent hike risk)
IMF fiscal review of Australian government
Bathla insolvency resolution and contagion spread
watch_list: RBA cash rate and forward guidance
Iron ore and LNG spot prices
Australian CPI and real wage data
Middle East oil supply / Brent crude
Bathla and private credit default rates
